chunks.text: Slow English podcast, A1 Love Emili.
Topic, Girocaster, part one.
Hello everyone.
My name is Emili.
Welcome to the Slow English podcast.
In this podcast, we speak slow and easy English.
Today we talk about a small and less known city in Europe.
The city is Girocaster.
Girocaster is in Albania.
Albania is a country in the Balkan region of Europe.
The city is in the south of the country.
Girocaster is not a very big city, but it is very special.
It has history, culture, and beautiful old buildings.
Part two, Girocaster is a very old city.
Many buildings in the city are hundreds of years old.
The houses in Girocaster are made of stone.
Because of this, people sometimes call it the stone city.
The roofs are gray and the streets are small and narrow.
Walking in the city feels like walking in the past.
Part three, the city is built on a hill.
This means many streets go up and down.
From the top of the hill, people can see beautiful mountains and green valleys.
The air is fresh and the view is amazing.
Many visitors enjoy walking slowly and looking at the landscape.
Part four, one of the most famous places in the city is Girocaster Castle.
The castle is very large and very old.
It stands on the top of the hill and looks over the city.
From the castle, visitors can see the whole city and the mountains around it.
Inside the castle, there is also a small museum.
The old town of Girocaster is very beautiful.
Many houses are traditional Ottoman style houses.
These houses have big stone walls and wooden windows.
Some houses are now museums.
Visitors can go inside and see how people lived many years ago.
It is a great way to learn about history.
Part six, Girocaster is also known for its culture and traditions.
Every year, the city hosts a big folklore festival.
During the festival, people come from many parts of Albania.
They sing traditional songs, play music and dance in traditional clothes.
The festival is colorful and exciting.
Part seven, food in Girocaster is simple but delicious.
Traditional Albanian food uses fresh ingredients.
One local dish is called chifchi.
It is made with rice, eggs and herbs.
People also eat grilled meat, vegetables and fresh bread.
Meals are often shared with family and friends.
Part eight, the people in Girocaster are friendly and welcome.
Life in the city is calm and peaceful.
Many people know each other.
Neighbors often talk in the streets or in small cafes.
Visitors often say the city feels warm and welcoming.
Part nine, the city also has small markets and shops.
In these shops, people sell handmade items.
You can find carpets, traditional clothes and small souvenirs.
Some shops sell local honey and homemade food.
Tourists enjoy walking through these markets.
Part ten, nature around Girocaster is very beautiful.
There are mountains, rivers and green fields.
People sometimes go hiking in the nearby hills.
Spring and autumn are very nice seasons to visit the area.
The weather is comfortable and the scenery is colorful.
Part eleven, Girocaster is also important for history.
The city is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
This means the city is very special for the culture of the world.
Many people come to study its architecture and history.
It is a small city, but it is very important.
Part twelve, Girocaster is quiet, historical and beautiful.
The stone houses, the castle and the mountain views make it unique.
Visitors can learn about Albanian culture and enjoy peaceful streets.
Even though it is not very famous, Girocaster is a wonderful place to visit.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Emily.
See you in the next episode.
